title: Pakistan Summons Indian Diplomat Over Killing of Two Pakistani Civilians at Border
detail: Pakistan summoned the Indian chargé d'affaires in Islamabad to formally protest the killing of two Pakistani civilians at the international border. The diplomatic demarche signals continued friction along the Pakistan-India border and comes amid an already comprehensive bilateral freeze that includes suspended trade, withdrawn ambassadors, and the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. Pakistan's Foreign Office condemned the incident and demanded accountability.
